articles.summary: Pennsylvania schools are seeking high-quality literacy solutions aligned to the Science of Reading; McGraw Hill Emerge! meets rising expectations in the state for reading instruction Key Highlights: McGraw Hill's Emerge! K-5 literacy program has been included on the Pennsylvania Department of Education's Curriculum Materials for Evidence-Based Reading Instruction list. The Pennsylvania list is designed to help the state’s 500 school districts make informed decisions regarding evidence-based reading curriculum materials for its 1.7 million students and highlights programs evaluated through nationally recognized review organizations. Emerge! provides comprehensive literacy instruction grounded in learning science and evidence-based science of literacy practices to support all learners in developing foundational and advanced literacy skills. articles.summary: McGraw Hill, Inc. (NYSE: MH; “McGraw Hill” and the “Company”), a leading global provider of education solutions for preK-12, higher education and professional learning, today announced that it has received upgraded ratings from SP Global Ratings. On September 18, 2026, SP Global Ratings upgraded McGraw-Hill Education, Inc.’s ratings, including its corporate family rating (CFR) to BB- from B+, its senior secured notes and senior secured first lien bank credit facility ratings to BB from BB- and its senior unsecured notes rating to B from B-. articles.title: S&P Global Ratings Upgrades McGraw Hill

articles.summary: Approvals span elementary, middle, and high school mathematics, expanding access to research-based, personalized learning solutions for Florida educators and students Key Highlights: Florida Department of Education approves McGraw Hill math instructional materials across elementary, middle, and high school mathematics courses. Approved materials include K-8 Florida Math core curriculum, Grades 6-7 Florida Math Accelerated, Algebra 1, Algebra 1 Honors, Geometry, Geometry Honors, Algebra 2, Algebra 2 Honors and Precalculus Honors. McGraw Hill Florida Math delivers research-based curriculum, personalized learning, and data-driven assessment and instructional support designed to improve student achievement and math confidence. TeachFX provides educators with their own private coach to learn about their strengths, improve their instructional practices and make the classroom experience engaging. TeachFX provides school leaders with aggregated classroom insights to identify instructional trends, focus coaching and better support teachers as they seek to improve their practice. articles.summary: McGraw Hill, Inc. (NYSE: MH), a leading global provider of education solutions for preK-12, higher education and professional learning, today announced that it will host an Investor Day on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, in New York City. The event will be in person and webcast and will begin at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time and conclude at approximately 12:30 p.m. Eastern Time. The event will be hosted by Philip Moyer, President, Chief Executive Officer; Dave Cortese, Executive Vice President, Chief Digital Information Officer; and Bob Sallmann, Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer, as well as other members of McGraw Hill’s executive leadership team. Executives will discuss McGraw Hill’s strategic priorities, growth initiatives, technology roadmap and financial framework. The event will also feature interactive product demonstrations and educator discussions and will conclude with a live question and answer session.
